sys_atf_test.description: Enables outbound webhooks via system property, creates a case with case_source=manual, updates severity from 3 to 1, and asserts NO outbound webhook_log entry was created. The Create Outbound Webhook business rule only fires for case_source=torq, so manual cases must be excluded.
sys_atf_test.name: Non-Torq Case Does Not Create Webhook
